description: Use when benchmarking travel nurse contract rates or negotiating with a staffing agency. Returns bill-rate medians and bands by specialty and state. Example: ICU travel nurse median bill rate $95/hr in Illinois, p75 $108/hr — agencies billing above $115/hr are 21% above market — renegotiation typically recovers $180K-$240K annually per 10 FTE travelers. Source: BLS and Stratalize SIA-style composite. $0.02 USDC per call.
name: get_travel_nurse_rate_benchmark
